Name: Paul Phoenix's Phoenix Smasher
Text: Knock Down-- If your rival played an attack this turn, this attack does +10 damage.

Name: Raven's Death From Above
Text: When your rival plays a projectile, you may reveal this card from your hand. If you do, your rival's attack is blocked, his action ends, and you must play this card first in your next action. Otherwise, you must pass your next action and discard this card

Name: Raven's Orbiting Moon
Text: When played, you may discard a kick from your hand to search your discard pile for a block.

Name: Wang Jinrei's Draong Power Punch
Text: Launcher-- When played, you may discard up to 5 blocks from your hand. Your rival discards the top 2 cards of his deck for each block you discarded in this way.

Name: Wang Jinrei's Energy Blast
Text: HIT - Shuffle X blocks from your discard pile into your deck. X = the damage this attack deals.

Name: Wang Jinrei's Heavy Uppercut
Text: Launcher-- Your next high attack this combo gains, "HIT - Search your deck for 2 blocks."

Name: Yoshimistu's Suicide
Text: Your rival may draw 3 cards. (*) HIT - You lose the round at the end of this action.

Name: Yoshimistu's Thunder Blade
Text: You may play this attack as an electric. (*) This attack does +X damage. X = the number of weapons in your rival's energy pile.

Name: Bryan Fury's Meteor Smash
Text: While in your energy pile when your rival plays a low attack, you may discard 2 cards in your energy pile to block that attack.

Name: Ganryu's Sumo Tackle
Text: When played while you have the card "Girth" in your discard pile, your rival must play an additional low block to block this attack.

Name: JACK-5's Gun Bomb
Text: When played, you may reveal the card "Metal Skin" from your hand to have your rival's attacks do -3 damage this turn.

Name: Julia Chang's Foot Stomp
Text: Your rival must be knocked down to play this attack.

Name: Kazuya Mishima's Lightning Screw Uppercut
Text: This attack does -2 damage for each non-electric used to pay for its cost.

Name: Paul Phoenix's Hammer of the Gods
Text: While your rival is knocked down, this attack does +6 damage and your action ends when this attack finishes.

Name: Raven's Quicksand
Text: Launcher-- This attack does +6 damage while you have 3 or more different kicks in your energy pile.

Name: Heihachi Mishima
Text: Your rival's attacks do -X damage. X = your energy minus your rival's energy to a minimum of 0. (*) You may play your attacks as electrics.(*) When you play an electric, your rival discards the top card of his deck.

Name: Dominated
Text: Flip during Set. Discard 4 face-down cards in your arena to gain +4 damage to your attacks this turn.

Name: The Devil Gene
Text: Your rival cannot play attacks this turn that share the same trait as any of the attacks in his energy pile. (*) Limit 1 per deck.
